field.name: Group name
help.type: select: pick manually. url-test: auto-picks the lowest-latency member. fallback: tries members in order, falling back on failure. load-balance: distributes across members by the chosen strategy.
help.proxies: Outbound nodes or other policy groups to include directly, by name.
help.use: Pulls in every member from one or more proxy sets (proxy-providers), by name — combined with any names listed under "proxies" above.
help.url: The health-check probe address (e.g. https://cp.cloudflare.com/generate_204). Only checks members listed under "proxies", not ones pulled in via "use".
help.tolerance: url-test only: a member is only switched to if it beats the current one by more than this many milliseconds.
help.lazy: When on, this group's members are only probed once the group is actually selected/used, cutting down on unnecessary probe traffic.
help.strategy: load-balance only: how traffic is distributed across members.
help.filter: Only keeps members (from "use") whose name matches this pattern; the pattern itself is configuration content executed by the Mihomo core — this tool never evaluates it.
help.exclude-filter: Excludes members (from "use") whose name matches this pattern; the pattern itself is configuration content executed by the Mihomo core — this tool never evaluates it.
